rules.statement: Supply is the last rising movement; Demand is the last falling movement. The movement may be one candle on a higher timeframe or several consecutive candles on a lower timeframe.
The movement forming the Demand/Supply zone must raid old liquidity.
Supply and Demand zones are untested/fresh. A later first test affects contextual eligibility but does not erase the historical zone object.
Supply is valid for sells in Premium; Demand is valid for buys in Discount. Stage 6.5 consumes an already-qualified Premium/Discount context and does not invent dealing-range endpoints.

Because SOURCE permits one or multiple consecutive candles but gives no deterministic segmentation algorithm for the 'last movement', the movement geometry requires auditable qualitative evidence with causal known_at rather than a fixed candle count or ATR threshold.
Movement+raid form the historical POI object. Premium/Discount and later first-test freshness are evaluated separately so future testing cannot retroactively delete the object.
